verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for an accounting SaaS, but nothing in the evidence shows sevDesk offering a chat, assistant, or natural-language command interface. The REST API and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks someone could use to build such an interface, and automatic booking-category suggestions are an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
